entities.summary: The Sofia and Oleksandr Rusov Chernihiv Regional Universal Scientific Library is a public library in Chernihiv, Ukraine. It is the largest library in the Chernihiv Oblast and is devoted to culture, education, history, and science. The library has over 800,000 documents, most of which are scientific reference books and publications. It is notable for its collection of over 15,000 rare editions from the 19th and early 20th centuries, including 5,700 from before the 1917 Russian Revolution.
